_meta.purpose: Real published figures for SLATE's land system: buying, holding, selling, combining and splitting vacant lots and acreage.
_meta.sourceTypes: primary = government, regulator, official statistics, or the authority's own page/document; secondary = press, trade body, broker, law firm or compilation site.
_meta.fieldConvention: Every figure carries value, unit, source, date, sourceType. Where a figure was not confirmed from a document fetched in this session, value is null and the gap is listed in 'uncertain'. 'confirmedThisSession': false marks a rule stated from a statute or page that was cited but whose text was not re-read in this session.
_meta.currencyNote: All amounts in the currency of the jurisdiction: USD (NY, CT, CA), GBP (England), EUR (Ireland), CAD (Ontario, BC), MXN (Mexico City).
correctionsToTheBrief: Ireland's 7.5% stamp duty on non-residential property (including land) applies to instruments executed on or after 9 October 2019, not from 2024 (Revenue).
NYC R2 minimum lot is no longer 3,800 sq ft: since City of Yes (ZR 23-11, last amended 5 Dec 2024) it is 2,850 sq ft and 30 ft wide for a single- or two-family detached house in R2/R2A/R2X/R3/R4/R5.
New Haven RS-2 minimum lot area was cut to 4,000 sq ft by ordinance OR-2021-0014 (adopted 4 Oct 2021); older sources still quote 7,500 sq ft.
MHCLG/VOA 'Land value estimates for policy appraisal' has not been updated since the 2019 edition (published 18 Aug 2020, values at April 2019). There is no 2024-2026 edition.
The FHFA residential land price dataset (Davis, Larson, Oliner, Shui) ends at 2022 (Version 4.0, June 2024); there is no 2025/2026 county figure.

USDA_NASS_LandValues2026.date: Land Values 2026 Summary, released 31 July 2026; values as of 1 January 2026
USDA_NASS_LandValues2026.note: Farm real estate = all land and buildings on farms. Connecticut is reported individually. Values read from the PDF tables (column order verified against the national headline figures).

FHFA_ResidentialLandPrices.source: https://www.fhfa.gov/document/land-prices_2024_20_june.xlsx (FHFA Working Paper 19-01, Davis, Larson, Oliner & Shui; page https://www.fhfa.gov/research/papers/wp1901)
FHFA_ResidentialLandPrices.method: Land under single-family homes, from GSE appraisals interpolated to all SF parcels. 'Standardized' = value of a quarter-acre lot; 'as-is per acre' = average actual land value per acre (small urban lots produce very high per-acre figures).
FHFA_ResidentialLandPrices.coverageNote: New York County (Manhattan) and Bronx County are not in the county panel.

knightFrankEnglishFarmlandIndex.scope: bare agricultural land, England and Wales (as reported)
knightFrankEnglishFarmlandIndex.note: Knight Frank is a private agent; the figure is reported by FarmingUK. Knight Frank's own PDF was not fetched.

savillsGBAverage.note: Savills page returned 403 in this session; figures from search extracts of Savills research. No Savills 2026 figure was found.

residentialDevelopmentLand.date: April 2019 values; published 18 Aug 2020; latest edition
residentialDevelopmentLand.unit: GBP/hectare, land with residential planning permission, 'typical' site
residentialDevelopmentLand.caveat: VOA/MHCLG state these are for policy appraisal only, not market values, and are highly sensitive to plot characteristics. Non-London figures assume a 35-unit, 3,150 sq m scheme.

agriculturalSCSITeagasc.sourceTypeNote: SCSI is the professional body; Teagasc is the state agriculture agency. Joint survey of agents' opinions, not a transaction register.

forecast2026.unit: % expected rise in land values in 2026

agriculturalSCSITeagasc.dublinNote: The survey's Leinster county table excludes Dublin; no Dublin agricultural figure is published.

residentialLand.note: No official Irish per-acre or per-hectare residential development land value series found. See uncertain.

FCC_FarmlandValues2025.sourceTypeNote: Farm Credit Canada is a federal Crown corporation. Values are FCC reference values for cultivated land; range = 90% of sales (top and bottom 5% excluded). The PDF was obtained from a mirror (fian.ca); FCC's own page shows the same provincial % changes.

cadastralUnitLandValues.note: The official 2026 'Valores unitarios de suelo y de la construcción' PDF exists at this URL but is a scanned image; no text could be extracted, so no per-m2 figure is recorded. Values are set per colonia catastral of three types: área (A), corredor (C), enclave (E). Per-parcel cadastral values are also in the SIGCDMX open data (https://sig.cdmx.gob.mx/datos/descarga).

stateAdditionalBaseTaxNYC_nonResidential.appliesTo: NYC conveyances of property other than residential real property where consideration is $2 million or more; so non-residential land in NYC at $2M+ pays 0.65% state tax

mansionTax.appliesTo: residential real property (1-3 family house, co-op, condo) at $1M or more; 'residential real property' is defined as premises that is or may be used as a personal residence
mansionTax.landNote: Whether a vacant lot counts: the definition turns on use as a residence. The Tax Department page does not say vacant land is excluded. See uncertain.

nycRPTT.threshold: applies to transfers over $25,000; return must be filed within 30 days even if no tax is due

stateConveyanceTaxUnimprovedLand.date: OLR report 9 July 2020 (CGS 12-494 as amended by PA 19-117)
stateConveyanceTaxUnimprovedLand.payer: seller, before the deed is recorded

municipalNewHaven.note: New Haven is one of the 19 eligible municipalities and, per the 2020 OLR report, imposes the maximum additional 0.25%.

totalVacantLandNewHaven.derivation: sum of the two published rates above

controllingInterestTransferTax.note: when an entity owning CT real property is transferred instead of the deed

cityOfLosAngeles.appliesTo: all real property in the City, including vacant land (ULA is not limited to residential)
cityOfLosAngeles.note: Thresholds are CPI-indexed each 1 July. ULA's application to all property types is from secondary summaries (the City FAQ returned 403).

reassessmentOnPurchase.value: assessed value resets to purchase price; then grows by the lesser of CPI or 2% a year (Prop 13)

sdltNonResidential.appliesToLand: Yes: agricultural land and 'any other land or property that is not part of a dwelling's garden or grounds' is non-residential. Land sold with a dwelling (e.g. cottage with fields) takes residential rates.

landRegistryFees.note: Compiled by a third party from the HM Land Registry fee order; the gov.uk HMLR fees page was not fetched.

stampDutyNonResidential.effective: instruments executed on or after 9 October 2019

residentialDevelopmentRefund.value: refund so that effective rate is 2% where land is developed for residential use (S83D TCA/SDCA)
residentialDevelopmentRefund.note: Revenue page names S83D; the 2% effective rate is from search extracts of Revenue, not the fetched page text.

provincialLTTOtherLand.appliesTo: land not containing one or two single-family residences (vacant land, commercial). Land with one or two single-family residences adds 2.5% above $2,000,000.

torontoMLTTOtherProperties.appliesTo: properties not containing one or two single-family residences, including vacant land

torontoMLTTResidentialLuxuryBands_2026_0.note: From search extract of toronto.ca; only relevant if the land has one or two single-family residences.

torontoMunicipalNonResidentSpeculationTa.appliesTo: non-residents buying certain residential property in Toronto, from 1 Jan 2025

propertyTransferTax.unit: CAD bands, % of fair market value
propertyTransferTax.note: PTT is on fair market value, not price. Farm-class land used for a dwelling: up to 0.5 ha treated as residential.

additionalForeignBuyerTax.note: Applies to foreign nationals/corporations/taxable trustees in specified areas; rate not confirmed in this session.

ISAI.structure: progressive: cuota fija plus factor applied to the excess over the lower limit of the band (Código Fiscal CDMX art. 113); 11 bands A-K
ISAI.vintage: UNCONFIRMED. The compilation says 'last update 21/09/2026', but the 19 Dec 2025 Gaceta decree updated the ISAI amounts for 2026 and other secondary sources quote different 2026 band limits. These may be the 2025 amounts. See uncertain.
ISAI.baseOfTax: the greater of price, cadastral value or appraised value (CFCDMX art. 116), confirmedThisSession: false

notaryAndRegistryFees.note: Not researched to a published figure.

titleInsuranceSurveyLegal.note: No official published price found for title insurance, boundary surveys or legal fees in any jurisdiction. NY title insurance premiums are filed rate manuals (TIRSA, regulated by NY DFS) but a figure was not extracted. See uncertain.

steps.step: Title search / official copy of title
steps.England: Official copy of register £7, title plan £3 (HM Land Registry; secondary compilation)
steps.others: Private abstract/title company search in US; cost not officially published

steps.NYC: ZoLa (NYC Planning) is free online; ZR text at zr.planning.nyc.gov
steps.LosAngeles: ZIMAS (LA City Planning) is free online
steps.note: No fee for looking up zoning online; confirmedThisSession: false for 'free'

cost.note: Neither EPA nor any state publishes a price. Vendor-published range: $2,200–$4,000 (2026) for a standard commercial parcel.

example.unit: USD non-refundable application fee (county witnesses the test; design professional digs holes; at least one deep hole of 4 ft minimum)
example.note: From a search extract of the county form, not a fetched copy; fee year not stated.

steps.stateForm: NYSDOH percolation test data form DOH-1327: https://www.health.ny.gov/forms/doh-1327.pdf

steps.rule: Since 1 January 2025 the NYS Freshwater Wetlands Maps no longer define DEC jurisdiction; an owner applies to NYSDEC for a parcel jurisdictional determination (and/or project determination). Previously mapped wetlands remain jurisdictional as wetlands of unusual importance.

maxFAR.unit: floor area ratio (standard lot); 1.00 for qualifying residential sites; for lots of 4,000 sq ft or more, one dwelling unit is capped at FAR 0.60

NYC_R2.byRight: single- or two-family detached or zero-lot-line residence (R2)
NYC_R2.existingSmallLots: Lots existing on 5 Dec 2024 below the minimum remain buildable if not reduced since.
NYC_R2.multipleBuildings: Minimum lot area multiplied by number of detached/zero-lot-line buildings on the zoning lot
NYC_R2.date: last amended 5 Dec 2024 (City of Yes for Housing Opportunity)

LosAngeles_R1.byRight: one single-family dwelling (plus ADU/JADU under state law)
LosAngeles_R1.note: Code page returned 403 to direct fetch; figures from search extract of the code text. Look-up tool: ZIMAS.

NewHaven_RS2.byRight: single-family detached; ADU as of right for owner-occupants

minAverageLotWidth.note: pre-2021 figure from zoneomics; may have changed with the 2021 amendment

England.rule: A new dwelling on vacant land needs planning permission (Town and Country Planning Act 1990). Permitted development rights attach to existing buildings and do not authorise a new house on an empty plot.

planningFees_from_2026_04_01.note: Local planning authority fee schedules (statutory national fees, indexed 1 April 2026); figures from search extracts of these documents.

Ireland.rule: A new house on a site requires planning permission from the county/city council; exempted development does not cover a new dwelling.

planningFeePerHouse.note: From search extracts of council-published Schedule 9.

Ontario.rule: Creating a new lot needs a consent (severance) from the Committee of Adjustment (Planning Act s.53) or a plan of subdivision (s.51).

BritishColumbia.rule: Subdivision requires approval by the municipal Approving Officer under the Land Title Act before a new plan can be registered.

MexicoCity.rule: Land use and density by the alcaldía's Programa Delegacional/Parcial de Desarrollo Urbano; a Certificado Único de Zonificación de Uso del Suelo states what can be built.

NYC.taxClassOfVacantLand: Class 1: vacant land zoned residential outside Manhattan, and (per RPTL 1802) vacant land of up to 10,000 sq ft immediately adjacent to a residence and owned by the same owner since 1 Jan 1989. Class 4: all other vacant land, including all vacant land in Manhattan.

taxRatesFY2026.date: Fiscal Year 2026 (July 2025–June 2026); FY2027 rates had not been posted by DOF as found in this session

assessmentCaps.class4: no cap; increases phased in (not confirmed this session)

NYC.effectiveRateDerivation: Class 1 vacant land ≈ 19.843% × 6% = about 1.19% of DOF market value before caps; Class 4 ≈ 10.848% × 45% = about 4.88% of DOF market value (before phase-in). These are arithmetic from published rates, not published effective rates.

NewYorkUpstate.note: No single rate: town + county + school district levies vary by parcel; equalization rates vary by municipality.

millRateFY2026_27.note: Board of Alders approved a $744.3M budget with a 1.42% tax increase (reported 27 May 2026); the Finance Committee settled on 'around 40' mills. The exact adopted mill rate was not confirmed.

cityOfLATotalRate.note: Base 1% plus voter-approved debt; secondary sources say about 1.2% in City of LA tax rate areas. The LA County Auditor-Controller Taxpayers' Guide 2025-26 was not retrieved.

annualAssessmentGrowthCap.unit: % per year max (lesser of CPI or 2%)

councilTax.note: Council tax is charged on dwellings; a vacant plot with no dwelling has none. confirmedThisSession: false

businessRates.note: Agricultural land and buildings are exempt from business rates (exempt since 1929); undeveloped land with no rateable occupation has none. Source for the agricultural exemption: https://www.cannockchasedc.gov.uk/business/business-rates/exemptions-business-rates (local authority)

residentialZonedLandTax.firstLiability: valuation date 1 Feb 2025, paid by 23 May 2025
residentialZonedLandTax.2026: valuation date 1 Feb 2026; return and payment by 23 May 2026; maps published by councils 31 Jan 2026
residentialZonedLandTax.appliesTo: land on the councils' annual final RZLT maps: zoned for residential (or mixed) use and serviced
residentialZonedLandTax.note: Figures from search extracts of these documents; the Revenue RZLT page URL tried returned 404.

localPropertyTax.note: LPT is charged only on residential property suitable for use as a dwelling; a bare site is not liable. confirmedThisSession: false

residentialTotalRate2026.unit: % of assessed value (city 0.605295 + education 0.153000 + City Building Fund 0.009016)
residentialTotalRate2026.note: Vacant land zoned residential is assessed in the residential class (confirmedThisSession: false).

commercialIndustrialVacantLand.note: Toronto says taxed at roughly 30% below the full commercial/industrial rate; exact rate not extracted.

class1Residential2026.unit: CAD per $1,000 of taxable value (general 1.93406, school 0.98001, TransLink 0.35893, BC Assessment 0.03814, Metro Vancouver 0.05260, MFA 0.00020)
class1Residential2026.note: City of Vancouver pages and council report (https://council.vancouver.ca/20260414/documents/r4b.pdf) returned 403; figure from search extract.

emptyHomesTax.appliesTo: Class 1 residential property in the City of Vancouver deemed or declared vacant; declaration due 3 Feb 2026 for the 2025 year
emptyHomesTax.note: Whether a bare lot with no dwelling is caught was not confirmed (vancouver.ca returned 403).

speculationAndVacancyTax.vacantLand: Applies to residential property including vacant residential land in specified areas (not properties assessed at $150,000 or less); the no-residence exemption existed only for 2018 and 2019. There is a land-under-development exemption.

predial.structure: bimonthly; progressive cuota fija + % on excess of cadastral value (CFCDMX art. 130); for land without construction the cadastral value is land area × valor unitario de suelo
predial.note: A compilation site shows a 16-band table (A–P) whose figures conflict with 2026 figures quoted elsewhere (e.g. band A upper limit $235,095.02, cuota $231.00, 0.02080%); neither could be confirmed against the 2026 Gaceta. See uncertain.

NYC.rule: No planning-board subdivision; a lot is split or merged by tax-lot apportionment/merger with the Department of Finance, and new lots must meet ZR minimum lot area/width (R2: 2,850 sq ft / 30 ft).

upstate.rule: Town/village planning board approves subdivision plats (Town Law 276, Village Law 7-728); fees set locally.

Connecticut.definition: Subdivision = division of a tract into three or more parts or lots for sale or building development (CGS 8-18). A single split into two (the 'first cut') is not a subdivision; lot-line changes are not subdivisions.

subdivisionMapAct.rule: Four or fewer parcels: parcel map; five or more: tentative and final map (Gov. Code 66426).

SB9UrbanLotSplit.rule: Ministerial parcel-map split of a single-family-zoned lot into two of roughly equal size; each at least 40% of the original and at least 1,200 sq ft (Gov. Code 66411.7), effective 1 Jan 2022.

LAParcelMapFee.note: LA City tentative-map fees seen ($13,579 for 5–49 single-family lots) predate the fee update the Council approved 20 Dec 2025, effective 23 Feb 2026; the parcel-map (4 or fewer) fee was not extracted.

England.rule: Splitting a plot needs a transfer of part registered at HM Land Registry; building on the new plot needs planning permission (see zoning.England.planningFees).
England.fee: HMLR Scale 1 registration fee applies to a transfer of part for value (secondary)

Ireland.rule: Splitting a folio is registered with Tailte Éireann (Land Registry); building needs planning permission (€65 per house fee).

severOneLotIntoTwo.unit: CAD (includes deed stamping) and/or new easement/right-of-way

committeeOfAdjustmentFees2026.requires: Draft reference plan of survey showing parts severed and retained
committeeOfAdjustmentFees2026.note: Fee table is laid out in two columns; the mapping of $6,561.48 and $4,040.33 to their lines was checked against the City's own summary quoted in search results.

BritishColumbia.note: Vancouver subdivision fees not researched to a figure.

subdivisionRelotificationMergerLicence.note: Compilation of the Código Fiscal; the rate is a percentage and unlikely to be affected by the annual peso-amount update, but not checked against the 2026 Gaceta.

lotMerger.note: Merger rules exist in each jurisdiction (e.g. CA Gov. Code 66451.10+, NYC DOF tax-lot merger, CDMX 'fusión' at 1% of appraisal) but fees other than CDMX were not confirmed.

nationalLandRealty2025.basis: 1,300+ land sales closed in 2025 where National Land Realty represented the seller; some counties 2–3 months, others a year
nationalLandRealty2025.sourceType: secondary (broker's own listings; not a market-wide statistic)

RLI_NAR_LandMarketReport2026.note: The 2026 REALTORS Land Institute / NAR Land Market Report (2025 data) publishes sales volume (+0.8%) and price per acre growth (+1.5%) but no days-on-market figure. Region 1 = CT, MA, ME, NH, NY, RI, VT; Region 5 = CA, NV.

olderNARClaim.note: A NAR land survey statement that most land sells in under 60 days (25% in under 30) circulates, but its year was not established; not used.

otherJurisdictions.note: No published time-to-sell for land found for England, Ireland, Ontario, BC or Mexico City.

uncertain: NYC FY2027 (July 2026–June 2027) property tax rates: not found posted; FY2026 rates recorded.

Whether NYS mansion tax (1%) reaches a vacant lot zoned residential: the statutory definition is 'premises that is or may be used ... as a personal residence'; the Tax Department page does not address vacant land. The brief's premise that it does not apply was not confirmed.
New Haven FY2026-27 adopted mill rate: budget approved with a 1.42% tax increase (May 2026); exact mills not confirmed (city pages returned 403). FY2025-26 was 39.4 mills (press).
New Haven municipal conveyance tax 0.5% is from a 2020 legislative report; not re-checked for 2026.
Los Angeles total property tax rate for City of LA tax rate areas (1% + voter debt, ~1.2% per secondary sources): LA County Auditor 2025-26 guide not retrieved.
LA City parcel map (4 or fewer lots) filing fee after the fee update effective 23 Feb 2026: not extracted.
Measure ULA applying to vacant land: from secondary summaries; LA City Finance FAQ returned 403.

Mexico City ISAI 2026 peso band amounts: the table recorded may be the 2025 amounts; the 19 Dec 2025 Gaceta decree updated them and the official 2026 text could not be retrieved (tjacdmx.gob.mx timed out; consejeria page 404). Also note an SCJN matter on ISAI constitutionality (Acuerdo General 9/2026, Sept 2026) whose outcome was not checked.
Mexico City predial 2026 tariff (art. 130): conflicting figures between sources; none recorded.
Mexico City cadastral unit land values per m2 for 2026: the official PDF is scanned images; no figure extracted.
Mexico City land market prices per m2 (e.g. Polanco, Condesa) exist only from brokers for built property, not land; not used.
Ireland residential development land value (Dublin or elsewhere): no official series found.
England: no 2026 Savills or RICS figure confirmed; Knight Frank Q2 2026 (£8,497/acre) is via press. RICS Rural Land Market Survey 2026 not retrieved.
England residential land values (VOA) are April 2019 and have not been updated; no newer official figure exists.
US residential land values (FHFA) end at 2022.
BC additional (foreign buyer) property transfer tax rate: not confirmed this session.
Vancouver 2026 Class 1 rate ($3.36394 per $1,000) and Empty Homes Tax treatment of bare lots: city pages returned 403; secondary only.
Toronto vacant commercial/industrial land tax rate: only described as ~30% below the full rate.
Title insurance premiums, boundary survey costs, conveyancing/legal fees: no official published figures found in any jurisdiction.
Phase I ESA cost: no EPA or state figure; only a vendor's range ($2,200–$4,000).
Percolation test fee: only Schenectady County's $100 application fee found (year not stated); other NY counties differ.
NYSDEC wetland jurisdictional determination fee and turnaround: not found.
Ireland S83D residential-development stamp duty refund (effective 2%): stated from search extracts, not fetched page text.
HM Land Registry fees: from a third-party compilation, not the gov.uk fee page.
England and Ireland planning fees: from council-published schedules via search extracts.
Days on market for land: only one broker's 2025 figure (125 days); no market-wide official statistic in any jurisdiction.

Items marked confirmedThisSession:false (statutory rules for CA parcel maps, CT 70% assessment, Ontario/BC subdivision process, England/Ireland planning requirement, LPT/council tax on bare land, NYC tax-lot merger) are standard law but their text was not re-read in this session.
